description: This file implements part of the Monitor plugin for WPEFramework, defining API endpoints for managing monitor configurations, resetting statistics, retrieving status, and signaling actions. It includes registration and unregistration of endpoints and external JSON data handling.

classes.name: Monitor
classes.description: A class providing monitoring API endpoints and event signaling within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace.

methods.name: RegisterAll
methods.description: Registers all API endpoints for the monitor plugin.

methods.name: endpoint_restartlimits
methods.description: Sets new restart limits for a plugin based on provided parameters.

methods.name: endpoint_resetstats
methods.description: Resets statistics for a specific plugin identified by callsign and populates response with current info.

methods.name: get_status
methods.description: Retrieves current memory and process statistics for a plugin or all plugins watched by the monitor.

methods.name: event_action
methods.description: Signals an action event taken by the monitor, with callsign, action, and reason.
